# Feel Your Protocol MCP Server — Use Layer (full text)
# Source: mcp-docs/use/ — end-user documentation for humans and AI agents
# https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/llms-full.txt
# Updated: 2026-08-31 — PUBLIC MCP NOT LAUNCHED; local stdio is developer early access only

================================================================================
READ FIRST — LAUNCH STATUS
================================================================================

The Feel Your Protocol MCP SERVER HAS NOT PUBLICLY LAUNCHED.
There is no hosted mcp.feelyourprotocol.org endpoint to connect today.

For interactive protocol exploration NOW: https://feelyourprotocol.org (live).

Local stdio gateway v0.1 exists for developers who clone and build mcp-gateway.
This documentation describes upcoming agent capabilities and the early-access local path.

================================================================================
LIVE MCP TOOLS (stdio v0.1, SELF-HOSTED ONLY) — READ SECOND
================================================================================

When the feel-your-protocol MCP server is connected, use these tools directly.
Do NOT fall back to mcp-execution-engine lab scripts or npm run lab unless MCP
is unavailable. Trust listTools on the connected server over stale repo text.

Tools:
- describe_capabilities (probe) — registry: forks, runnable EIP modules, opcodes, encoding
- run_evm_bytecode (run) — run raw bytecode under fork config

Compare gas or outcomes optionally by calling run twice (e.g. osaka then amsterdam).

Server: FeelYourProtocol v0.1.0
Setup: see CONNECT section below

JSON schemas:
- /schemas/describe_capabilities.input.json
- /schemas/run_evm_bytecode.input.json

================================================================================
INTRODUCTION
================================================================================

Status: PUBLIC MCP NOT LAUNCHED. Website explorations LIVE at feelyourprotocol.org.
Local stdio v0.1 = developer early access only. Remote HTTP Step 5.

Headless MCP server wrapping EthereumJS for exact, deterministic simulations of
the future Ethereum protocol. Rich JSON traces for agent reasoning.

Mental model: explorations website = textbook; MCP server = lab equipment.
Vision: roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org

================================================================================
CAPABILITIES
================================================================================

Query shapes and MCP tools:

- Probe → describe_capabilities — LIVE (stdio)
- Run → run_evm_bytecode — LIVE (stdio)
- Generate (BAL) — planned Step 6

Optional: compare baseline vs preview by calling run twice (osaka then amsterdam).

Scope: stateless/BYOS, raw bytecode only, no Solidity compile, no archive node,
no multi-block historical backtesting.

================================================================================
CONNECT
================================================================================

Public MCP: NOT LAUNCHED (mcp.feelyourprotocol.org planned).
Local stdio: developer early access only — build from source.
Most users: feelyourprotocol.org explorations (no MCP setup).

Build:
  cd mcp-execution-engine && npm ci && npm run build
  cd ../mcp-gateway && npm ci && npm run build

Cursor mcp.json:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "feel-your-protocol": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/mcp-gateway/dist/index.js"]
    }
  }
}

After gateway code changes: npm run build + restart MCP in Cursor (Settings → MCP).

Startup stderr should show:
  [fyp-mcp] FeelYourProtocol v0.1.0 ready — tools: describe_capabilities, run_evm_bytecode

================================================================================
TOOL: DESCRIBE_CAPABILITIES (LIVE)
================================================================================

MCP tool name: describe_capabilities
Input: {} (no required fields)
Output: engineVersion, ceilings, baselineForkId, namedForks, eips (runnable modules with opcodes + encoding + comparison; no demo programs), allowedBaseHardforks

Use first to learn baselineForkId (osaka — current mainnet EL), prague (pre-Fusaka ModExp compare), preview fork amsterdam (alias glamsterdam), and runnable EIPs (8024, 7883 ModExp, 7951 secp256r1). Unimplemented EIPs are omitted.

================================================================================
TOOL: RUN_EVM_BYTECODE (LIVE)
================================================================================

MCP tool name: run_evm_bytecode

Purpose: Run raw EVM bytecode under fork/EIP config. Returns gas, stack, optional
trace, provenance.

Inputs:
- bytecode (required): hex, max 24576 bytes
- fork (optional): { baseHardfork, eips[] } — default amsterdam; use osaka for mainnet baseline comparisons
- gasLimit (optional): string, default 1000000, max 30000000
- trace (optional): boolean, max 10000 steps

Outputs: success, gasUsed, returnValue, finalStack, error, steps?, provenance

Amsterdam note: eips: [] on amsterdam is correct — EIP-8024 bundled in hardfork.
Optional 8024 compare: run same bytecode on osaka (baseline, invalid 0xe6–0xe8) then amsterdam (preview).

Examples:
- PUSH1 STOP: bytecode 0x600100 → gasUsed 3
- EIP-8024 EXCHANGE: 0x6001600260036004e88e00, trace true → ~15 gas
- EIP-8024 DUPN deep stack: 0x600160026003600460056006600760086009600a600b600c600d600e600f60106011e68000

================================================================================
COVERAGE
================================================================================

Named forks: prague (ModExp compare), osaka (baseline, alias mainnet-el), amsterdam (preview, alias glamsterdam).
baselineForkId: osaka. Live runnable EIP modules: 8024, 7883, 7951.
Exploration twins (human catalogue): 8024, 7883, 7951 runnable; 7928 planned (generate). See use/eips/.

================================================================================
GUARANTEES
================================================================================

Deterministic execution. Provenance on every result. Limits:
- Max gas 30000000, default 1000000
- Max bytecode 24576 bytes
- Max trace steps 10000

Out of scope: Solidity compile, ERC layer, multi-block backtesting.

================================================================================
PRICING
================================================================================

Not shipped. x402 planned Steps 8-9. See roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org.

================================================================================
FOR AI AGENTS
================================================================================

1. If feel-your-protocol MCP connected → use describe_capabilities and
   run_evm_bytecode (once on amsterdam by default; optionally osaka for mainnet comparison).
   Do not use local lab as substitute.
2. Cite provenance.engineVersion and provenance.forkConfig in answers.
3. Index: /llms.txt. Schemas: /schemas/*.input.json

Vision on roadmap; this file is operational reference.
